sourceFormat: Rokoko FBX, 30 seconds, source rest-world positions in authoring centimetres
conversion: one source rest-world conversion into three-vrm-3.5.5 normalized-local-absolute tracks; the measured facing correction is applied to hips displacement and every world quaternion delta
sourceSampleRule: sample FBX at 1/30 for the first held sample, then every 1/30 through 899/30 and repeat the final sample at 30s
unitRule: source hips rest is 94.00000000000125 authoring units; each target uses measured target rest hip and configured shoe floor to derive metres-per-source-unit
limitations: No browser playback, floor/contact, garment, expression, visual, or game acceptance was run
Exact avatar SHA and footwear SHA are embedded in each normalized clip
